blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — The families of Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo and Presidential Legislative Liaison Office (PLLO) Secretary Joey Salceda remembered their departed loved ones in Camarines Sur and Albay on Sunday, November 1, in observance of All Saints’ Day.
